artworks.title: Flower Bed
artworks.description: A bright Eastbourne flower bed gathered into a joyful study of colour, leaves and late-season light.
artworks.alt: Colourful flower beds in Eastbourne rendered as a painterly local scene

artworks.title: Seven Sisters from the Gardens
artworks.description: Chalk cliffs, changing skies and a view that opens slowly from the gardens above the Sussex coast.
artworks.alt: The Seven Sisters chalk cliffs seen from a garden above the Sussex coast

artworks.title: Beachy Head
artworks.description: A tall, quiet portrait of the downland landmark where paths, chalk and weather meet.
artworks.alt: A portrait-format view of the downland and landmark at Beachy Head

artworks.title: Meet Me in Eastbourne
artworks.description: A broad Eastbourne view shaped by the town, the sea and the invitation to meet somewhere familiar.
artworks.alt: A wide painterly view across Eastbourne towards the sea

artworks.title: Eastbourne Pier
artworks.description: The pier held against sea and sky: a familiar Eastbourne silhouette seen with fresh attention.
artworks.alt: Eastbourne Pier extending into the sea beneath a bright sky

artworks.title: Beach Huts, Eastbourne
artworks.description: A row of Eastbourne beach huts turned into a small celebration of colour, rhythm and seaside days.
artworks.alt: Colourful beach huts arranged along Eastbourne seafront

artworks.title: South Downs I
artworks.description: A wide South Downs landscape of open fields, soft light and rolling Sussex horizons.
artworks.alt: Open fields and rolling hills across the South Downs in Sussex

artworks.title: Battle Abbey
artworks.description: Historic stone, green grounds and the quiet atmosphere of Battle Abbey in East Sussex.
artworks.alt: The historic grounds and stone architecture of Battle Abbey in East Sussex

artworks.title: Sovereign Harbour Waterfront
artworks.description: A spacious waterfront view where boats, buildings and open Eastbourne light meet.
artworks.alt: A wide waterfront view of boats and buildings at Sovereign Harbour

artworks.title: Long Man
artworks.description: The Long Man of Wilmington standing quietly against the chalk downland of Sussex.
artworks.alt: The Long Man of Wilmington figure set into the Sussex chalk hills

artworks.title: Eastbourne Sunset
artworks.description: Warm evening colour settling over Eastbourne, the sea and the edge of the day.
artworks.alt: A warm sunset over Eastbourne and the Sussex coast

artworks.title: Martello 66
artworks.description: A familiar Martello tower held against the changing light of the East Sussex coast.
artworks.alt: Martello tower 66 on the East Sussex coast

artworks.title: South Downs Cat at Sunrise
artworks.description: A quiet sunrise encounter on the South Downs, with a cat, grasses and wide morning light.
artworks.alt: A cat at sunrise among the grasses of the South Downs

artworks.title: Devils Dyke
artworks.description: Layered hills and open sky above the dramatic downland valley of Devils Dyke.
artworks.alt: The rolling hills and valley of Devils Dyke in Sussex

artworks.title: Parapente in the South Downs

artworks.alt: A paraglider flying above the South Downs landscape

artworks.title: Sovereign Harbour
artworks.description: A detailed harbour view with boats, water and the calm geometry of Sovereign Harbour.
artworks.alt: Boats and water at Sovereign Harbour in a detailed coastal view
